digest.component_or_area: documentation: CLI help, ticket model, event schema
propositions: The packaged CLI overview (src/rebar/_cli/help/overview.txt) states unlink has no relation argument, contradicting the current optional relation accepted by rebar unlink and rebar.unlink.

The ticket-model documentation (docs/ticket-model.md) claims unlink <source> <target> takes no relation argument, which contradicts the implemented optional relation-scoped unlink shipped in commit 73abb5805f.
Documentation surfaces omit the most-recent fallback behavior when relation argument is omitted, and do not distinguish exact relation-scoped removal from pair-scoped removal.
The event-schema operation wording conflates optional relation selection with the emitted UNLINK link-UUID cancellation event, lacking clarity on both semantics.

Commit 73abb5805f updated subcommand help and generated references but omitted independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md, creating a documentation gap verified by live `rebar --help` contradiction against `rebar unlink --help`.
